extracted.intended_audience: Chief, Executive and Planning Division; CIA Office of Security and internal staff
extracted.subtask_short: CIA memo: OMB Circular A-44 reply
extracted.subtask_description: Internal CIA memorandum providing data for inclusion in the Office of Security reply to implementation of OMB Circular A-44 (Revised), reporting items under Management Effectiveness Goals and a negative report for Cost Reduction Goals, with an attachment about Security Education Program scheduling.

rubrics_metrics.name: Management Effectiveness Goals
rubrics_metrics.description: Staff has one item to report under Section 1, 'Management Effectiveness Goals'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The attached memorandum from the Chief, Training Branch, A&TS itemizes a change in the scheduling and timing of the Security Education Program which increased management effectiveness by releasing a Training Officer to participate in other briefings and training requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cost Reduction Goals
rubrics_metrics.description: Section II, 'Cost Reduction Goals' receives a negative report.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Although scheduling changes allowed one Training Officer to give the entire Program where two were previously required, this change 'has not resulted in any cost reduction in our overall training program.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Security Education Program scheduling and staffing efficiency
rubrics_metrics.description: Change in scheduling/timing of the Security Education Program reduced instructor staffing requirement from two Training Officers to one for the entire Program.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consequence: did not yield measurable cost reductions but produced a management effectiveness benefit by freeing a Training Officer for other duties; itemized in attached memorandum from Chief, Training Branch, A&TS.
